headline: Rane Holdings Limited: Acquisition
sum: Acquisition - The Finance Committee of the Board of Directors of the Company at their meeting held today, have, inter alia, approved further investment of equity in the joint venture M/s. ZF LIFETEC Rane Automotive India Private Limited.
detail: Acquisition - The Finance Committee of the Board of Directors of the Company at their meeting held today, have, inter alia, approved further investment of equity in the joint venture M/s. ZF LIFETEC Rane Automotive India Private Limited. The meeting concluded at 11:15 AM
